instruction: Use GIMP to export the file "/home/user/logo.png" to Adobe InDesign ".indd" format.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot export to INDD (Adobe InDesign) format. INDD is a proprietary desktop publishing format used by Adobe InDesign, and GIMP, being a raster graphics editor, has no support for this format.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP cannot export to Adobe InDesign .indd format
The infeasible() evaluator function exists in the metrics library and is appropriate for impossible tasks
Metadata clearly explains why the task cannot be completed (GIMP has no support for proprietary INDD format)
No verification logic is needed since the task should never succeed
Evaluator correctly identifies this as an impossible task that cannot be verified
